answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique LBL acoustic position fix, treating the thermocline-refracted inlet as a physical attestation channel that a single hull cannot occupy twice. Every voyage of a node is logged as a signed Doppler dead-reckoning trace, and peers cross-correlate these traces as sonnet's repeated refrain to flag cloned. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
